now-sdk dependencies [sysIds..]

Download configured dependencies in now.config.json and typescript type
definitions for use in the application

Parameters:
  sysIds  System IDs to add when using --add flag          [array] [default: []]

Options:
  -d, --debug           Print debug output            [boolean] [default: false]
      --directory       Path to the directory that contains package.json
                        configuration
  [string] [default: "/work/projects/my-app/.claude/worktree
                                                            s/sdk-panel-22ceb0"]
  -a, --auth            Credential alias to use for authentication with instance
                                                                        [string]
      --type-defs-only  Download only script type definitions (glide.*.d.ts)
                                                                       [boolean]
      --fluent-only     Download only fluent types from now.config.json
                        dependencies                                   [boolean]
      --add             Add new dependency items (table name, e.g., actions,
                        triggers, sys_security_acl)                     [string]
      --scope           Scope for dependencies (e.g., global, x_my_app).
                        Required when using --add                       [string]
  -h, --help            Show help                                      [boolean]
  -v, --version         Show version number                            [boolean]
